about: Target bands for the balance loop (the plan's Phase 1), drafted from the round 1 baseline. strength: every weapon, class, item and ability's rating (team-margin plus-minus a match, from sweep.py) within spread of its slot's median, at each aim level listed. range: a primary's rank among the primaries by the damage a second it lands on a strafing Medium in threat_probe, per range band (1 is best).
